english: Come with me to India, baby.
chinese: 请跟我来印度，宝贝。

english: I can't make it for everything that's happened, but I can promise you my undying love.
chinese: 我不能为所有的发生的事情而改变，但我保证我的永恒爱恋。

english: I will be the most devoted husband and I will cherish you always.
chinese: 我将是最忠诚的丈夫，我会永远爱你。

english: Steven, I can't just leave everything at the drop of a hat
chinese: 对不起，我无法直接翻译中文。不过，我可以尝试用英文来表达你的意思：

english: with everything that has happened between us.
chinese: 一切发生过的，都与我们有关。

english: I just don't know you anymore.
chinese: 我只知道你了。

english: I just can't build a relationship on a foundation of lies.
chinese: 我根本不能建立在谎言之上的关系。

english: I do love you, but I can't go with you.
chinese: 我爱您，但我不愿意跟着你。

english: I'm sorry. I love you.
chinese: 我非常抱歉。我爱你。

english: This is the last call for flight A15 from Los Angeles to Hyderabad.
chinese: 这是从洛杉矶飞往赫尔默特的最后呼叫。

english: I'm sorry, sir. We can't wait any longer. You must board the plane.
chinese: 对不起，先生。我们不能再等了。您必须登机。

english: Are you waiting for someone?
chinese: 是等某人吗？

english: I was, but I don't think she's coming.
chinese: 我曾经，但我不认为她会来。

english: So, Marco, I think I see a bit of a tear there in the corner of your eye.
chinese: 所以，马科，我似乎看到了你眼睛角落的一丝泪痕。

english: I'm very sad. I can't believe he proposed and she just said no, just like that.
chinese: 我非常难过。他提出，她却只是说不，就像这样。

english: It's not supposed to happen.
chinese: 它不会发生。

english: Plus, he was inviting her to India and exotic getaway and promising.
chinese: 此外，他还邀请她去了印度和异国情调的度假，并承诺。

english: Exotic getaway for the rest of her life.
chinese: 外太空的度假，她将永远享受。

english: Well, what do you think will happen?
chinese: 好的，你认为会发生什么？

english: Part 10, it all ends.
chinese: 第10部分，一切结束了。

english: So, do you think they all just keep on living their separate lives?
chinese: 所以，你们是不是都只是各自的生活？

english: Will they meet again?
chinese: 将这句话翻译成中文，可以得到以下结果：

english: Who knows? Come to our website and tell us what you think will happen.
chinese: 谁也不知道？来我们的网站，告诉我们你认为会发生什么。

english: So, you can find us at englispod.com.
chinese: 所以，您可以在这里找到我们：englispod.com。

english: Alright, don't miss our finale of this lesson and until next time, we'll see you guys there.
chinese: 好的，别忘了我们的课程总结会，直到下一次见！
